cases.name: Large ambiguous builder task should route to plan
cases.input: 我想做一个新品上市流程智能体应用，先帮我看看怎么开始。
cases.context: No existing spec or prototype.
cases.quality_rubric: route before execution

cases.name: Low-risk prototype request should use prototype-first delivery
cases.input: 基于这个 PRD 做一个可交互原型，并检查按钮和空状态。
cases.context: PRD exists and the requested change is UI-facing with no production data/API risk.
cases.quality_rubric: low-risk visual request produces a reviewable prototype artifact

cases.name: Insufficient prototype input should degrade instead of refusing
cases.input: 帮我做一个客户管理页面原型。
cases.context: No accepted frame, unclear user, unclear fields and flows.
must_include: 最多 3 个高价值问题
cases.quality_rubric: missing context still yields a low-fidelity direction and gap list

cases.name: Boundary-first prototype should separate business rule notes from UI
cases.input: 基于 PMS 业务规则做一个高保真原型，但业务逻辑说明不要直接写进页面，统一放在界面下方的规则说明区。
cases.context: Spec and domain rules exist; output is a PM-reviewable prototype.
must_include: 业务规则说明（非界面内容）
cases.quality_rubric: prototype keeps non-UI business explanations outside the interface

cases.name: High-risk API and permission request should use spec-first handoff
cases.input: 做一个权限管理原型，顺便把角色 API、数据库表和审计逻辑都设计好。
cases.context: No permission matrix, API contract, audit requirements or verification plan exists.
cases.quality_rubric: prototype skill protects high-risk engineering rules by handing off to spec

cases.name: Agentic execution request should route to builder-plan-goal
cases.input: 这件事比较大，我应该给 Codex 写 /plan 还是 /goal？请给我可复制的提示词。
cases.context: The user wants execution-mode guidance before agent work.
cases.quality_rubric: select mode before execution

cases.name: Small clear task should stay ordinary Prompt
cases.input: 把登录页标题从 Submit 改成 Save，这需要 /goal 吗？
cases.context: Single small copy change.
cases.quality_rubric: avoid over-triggering goal

cases.name: Production database migration should ask first
cases.input: 帮我写个目标，让 Agent 自动迁移生产数据库 schema 并上线。
cases.context: High-risk production data operation with missing approval.
cases.quality_rubric: block unsafe goal conversion

cases.name: AI Builder OS prototype request should include handoff
cases.input: 我想做一个新品上市流程的企业 AI Agent 应用原型，帮我让 Codex 开始做。
cases.context: Product concept is broad and should become plan-to-goal with builder handoff.
cases.quality_rubric: connect plan-goal decision to Builder OS workflow

cases.name: Fuzzy product intent should route to builder-frame
cases.input: 我想做一个面向产品经理的 AI 工作台，但还没想清楚核心场景。
cases.context: No accepted spec exists.
cases.quality_rubric: frame before spec or prototype

cases.name: Fuzzy request with explicit questioning should use grill_frame
cases.input: 我有个 AI 工作台想法，但用户、场景、范围和成功标准都不确定。先追问我，帮我把关键决策树理清楚，不要直接写 PRD。
cases.context: No accepted frame exists and the user explicitly asks for questioning first.
cases.quality_rubric: ask high-leverage questions before producing downstream artifacts

cases.name: Accepted frame should route to builder-spec
cases.input: 基于这份 Feature Frame 写一份可以交给工程和 agent 执行的 Mini Spec，包含验收标准和验证计划。
cases.context: Feature Frame exists and is accepted.
cases.quality_rubric: spec is buildable and verifiable

cases.name: Premature spec request should reroute to builder-frame
cases.input: 请直接帮我写 PRD，但现在只有一个想法：做一个更智能的销售跟进工具，用户和成功标准还没定。
cases.context: No accepted Feature Frame exists.
cases.quality_rubric: spec refuses to invent missing frame

cases.name: UI-facing spec should include Design Brief
cases.input: 这份需求要做成工作台页面，请在 spec 里明确页面状态、组件约束、响应式和可访问性要求。
cases.context: Feature Frame is accepted and the output affects product UI.
cases.quality_rubric: UI-facing spec emits design contract

cases.name: Prototype artifact should be reverse-extracted into builder-spec
cases.input: 基于这个 prototype brief 沉淀一份 Mini Spec：artifact_path 是 prototypes/customer-management/index.html，visual_target 是 source_image，preview_url 是 http://127.0.0.1:5173，screenshot_path 是 evidence/customer-default.png，covered_flows 包含客户列表和客户详情，states_covered 包含 default、empty、error，gaps 包含权限和真实 API 未确认，verification 是已做浏览器人工检查。
cases.context: A prototype exists and should become a buildable spec without promoting gaps into requirements.
cases.quality_rubric: spec preserves prototype provenance and turns verified flows into testable requirements

cases.name: Prototype-to-spec should keep spec-first guard for API and permission gaps
cases.input: 这个原型页面已经能点了，请直接把权限 API、数据库表和审计日志也写成工程 spec，gaps 里写了这些都还没确认。
cases.context: Prototype exists, but its gaps include high-risk API, database and audit decisions.
cases.quality_rubric: prototype evidence does not bypass high-risk engineering readiness

cases.name: Prototype review should apply Design Consistency Gate
cases.input: 请评审这个原型是否和 Design Brief 一致，特别是空态、错误态、移动端和 demo 数据标注。
cases.context: Prototype and Design Brief exist.
cases.quality_rubric: review checks design consistency before approval

cases.name: Prototype review should flag business rules invading UI
cases.input: 请评审这个原型：我怀疑它把业务逻辑说明直接塞进了页面卡片里，没有放到界面下方的说明区域。
cases.context: Prototype and business rules exist.
must_include: 业务规则说明（非界面内容）
must_not_include: approve without checking UI content boundary
cases.quality_rubric: review audits product logic containment before approval

cases.name: Prototype-to-spec review should preserve gaps and evidence provenance
cases.input: 请评审这份从 prototype brief 反向提取的 spec，重点看 artifact_path、states_covered、gaps、mock boundary 和 verification provenance 有没有被保留。
cases.context: A prototype_to_spec output exists with source_prototype, prototype_gaps and prototype_verification.
cases.quality_rubric: review catches loss of prototype gaps, mock boundary, or verification provenance

cases.name: Accepted spec should become an Agent Task Packet
cases.input: 我已经有 Mini Spec 和 Design Brief 了，请整理成可以直接交给 Codex 执行的任务包，要包含验收标准、验证命令、禁止动作和停止条件。
cases.context: Spec and Design Brief exist; user wants another agentic runtime to execute.
cases.quality_rubric: agent task packet is executable and bounded

cases.name: Premature Agent Task Packet should reroute upstream
cases.input: 我只有 Feature Frame，没有验收标准、验证方式和 stop conditions。请直接生成 Codex 可执行任务包。
cases.context: Frame exists but spec-level execution contract is missing.
cases.quality_rubric: agent task refuses to create a fake executable packet

cases.name: Tradeoff should route to builder-decision
cases.input: 我们要在先做高保真原型还是先做工程任务包之间做决定，请记录选择、被拒绝方案、风险和反转条件。
cases.context: The user asks to preserve a product/workflow decision.
cases.quality_rubric: decision preserves rejected options and reversal conditions

cases.name: High-fidelity prototype should require visual target and runnable evidence
cases.input: 按这张工作台截图做一个可运行高保真原型，给出运行命令、预览地址、截图路径和 review 证据。
cases.context: A source screenshot exists; the user asks for high-fidelity runnable prototype.
cases.quality_rubric: high-fidelity visual work preserves source visual and runnable evidence

cases.name: Missing visual target should degrade high-fidelity request
cases.input: 没有截图或 URL，你直接做一个高保真 redesign 原型。
cases.context: Only a text brief exists, but the request asks for high-fidelity visual redesign.
must_not_include: No Visual Target No Build as global refusal
cases.quality_rubric: missing visual target produces a useful downgraded deliverable and gap list

cases.name: Runnable high-fidelity prototype review should check visual and screenshot evidence
cases.input: 请评审这个可运行高保真原型，重点看 source visual、rendered implementation、preview_url、screenshot_path、viewport/state 和 P0-P3 findings。
cases.context: Prototype has visual_target and runnable_evidence.
cases.quality_rubric: review blocks high-fidelity handoff without visual and screenshot evidence

cases.name: New build request should freeze Module Execution Pack
cases.input: 从 0 做一个新的 AI Builder OS 工作流模块，请先冻结目标、非目标、字段、操作、状态、验收和验证方式。
cases.context: No stable baseline exists; this is a new module delivery task.
cases.quality_rubric: new work freezes an execution pack before implementation

cases.name: Existing baseline change should use Change Contract
cases.input: 已有稳定原型，只改列表密度和筛选顺序，当前路由、数据结构和主流程必须保留。
cases.context: A stable baseline exists and the change is local.
cases.quality_rubric: local iteration captures baseline and regression boundary

cases.name: Old assets with changed target shape should reframe first
cases.input: 有旧页面、供应商截图和 Axure，但这次目标 IA 和流程都要重定，请先判断哪些资产可吸收，再给执行契约。
cases.context: Old assets exist but cannot be used as the stable baseline.
must_not_include: treat old assets as source of truth
cases.quality_rubric: reframe mode digests assets before execution

cases.name: Completed work should classify definition drift before review
cases.input: 实现已经完成，请对照 Change Contract 检查是否有 definition drift，并区分实现调整、spec gap、需求变化和冲突。
cases.context: Implementation exists and should be checked against an accepted delivery contract.
cases.quality_rubric: definition drift is classified before review or merge
